video.description: Source video to render text onto (MP4 or MOV), at most 50 MB.
video.title: Video

texts.description: Text variants to render, one output video per entry. Up to 4 — the point is testing several hooks against the same footage in one call.
examples: I tried this for a week
texts.title: Texts

fonts.description: Font per variant, aligned by position with texts. Blank entries let Mirage decide. Omit entirely to auto-pick every font.
fonts.title: Fonts

sizes.description: Font size in pixels per variant, aligned by position with texts. Blank entries auto-decide.
sizes.title: Sizes

colors.description: Text colour per variant as #RRGGBB, aligned by position with texts. Blank entries auto-decide.
colors.title: Colors
